premise: With official FAE infrastructure unavailable, a genuinely fresh device must have an independently specified path to discover peers, synchronize, validate, and become mining-capable; post-bootstrap peer gossip alone is not sufficient evidence of cold-start independence.

phases.name: zero-seed control
phases.requirement: fresh node, empty peer set, no persisted descriptors; prove current behavior explicitly

phases.name: independent bootstrap topology
phases.requirement: fresh node receives only non-official bootstrap roots and reaches a diverse authenticated peer set

phases.name: sync and validate
phases.requirement: node reconstructs preferred chain from those peers with normal validation

phases.name: mining readiness
phases.requirement: after sync, node can obtain/create valid mining work without official control-plane dependency

phases.name: real-WAN evidence
phases.requirement: repeat over independently administered hosts/networks; external evidence gate

current_evidence: Configured peers can seed authenticated peer discovery; peer descriptors then expand the candidate set.
Independent Node v1.1 proves coordinator-off operation, partition/reconnect recovery and bootstrap from a manually supplied peer.
Production bootstrap requirements/nodes remain intentionally unset.
acceptance: A fresh node with zero peer roots is a negative control, not a required impossible property.
At least one bootstrap mechanism/root-of-contact must be specified; independence is demonstrated by absence of dependence on official FAE infrastructure, not by discovery from mathematical nothing.
Bootstrap root failure/compromise must fail closed or preserve a path to diverse independently controlled alternatives.
